question: What substitute action is prescribed when one cannot perform śrāddha during the ancestors' fortnight?
premises: Inability to perform śrāddha is the condition
The time is the ancestors' fortnight
inference: If unable to perform śrāddha in the ancestors' fortnight, one should feed brāhmaṇas.
plain_english: O beloved, if unable to perform śrāddha during the fortnight of the ancestors, one should feed brāhmaṇas.
